issues.issue: Should the three news articles be admitted as new evidence under section 110(4)?
issues.applicant_position: The articles arose after the rejection and are relevant to terrorism in the proposed IFA locations.
issues.result_text: RAD admits the three news articles as new evidence; they meet s.110(4) as new and relevant.

issues.issue: Should an oral hearing be held under section 110(6)?
issues.applicant_position: Requests an oral hearing under section 110(6) because the new evidence raises credibility issues.
issues.result_text: No discretion to hold a hearing: the new evidence lacks materiality and the RAD proceeds on the record.

issues.issue: Should the psychotherapist's report be given weight?
issues.applicant_position: RPD failed to consider the psychotherapist report diagnosing an anxiety disorder and other conditions.
issues.result_text: The author is not authorised to diagnose; the RAD gives no weight to the report.

issues.issue: Is an internal flight alternative available in Hyderabad, Multan or Lahore, including whether the TTP could track him there?
issues.applicant_position: RPD misstated his risk as a sub-leader of volunteers and ignored documents on risk to local peace committee members.
issues.result_text: No serious possibility of TTP persecution in the proposed IFA cities; no evidence the TTP could track him there.

issues.issue: Would relocation to those cities be unreasonable, causing undue hardship?
issues.applicant_position: There is no safe place in Pakistan; the Taliban could track him through government and police networks.
issues.result_text: RAD agrees relocation to Hyderabad, Multan or Lahore would not be unreasonable; no undue hardship is shown.
